scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run db:generate --prefix server
scripts.railway:migrate: cd server && npx prisma db push && node prisma/seed.js
